source: Transliterated from the Urdu translation of Maulana Muhammad Junagarhi.

ayahs.1: Qasam hai sooraj ki aur us ki dhoop ki.
ayahs.2: Qasam hai chaand ki jab us ke peechhe aaye.
ayahs.3: Qasam hai din ki jab sooraj ko numaayaan kare.
ayahs.4: Qasam hai raat ki jab use dhaanp le.
ayahs.5: Qasam hai aasman ki aur us ke banaane ki.
ayahs.6: Qasam hai zameen ki aur use hamwaar karne ki.
ayahs.7: Qasam hai nafs ki aur use durust banaane ki.
ayahs.8: Phir samajh di us ko badkaari ki aur bach kar chalne ki.
ayahs.9: Jis ne use paak kiya woh kaamyaab hua.
ayahs.10: Aur jis ne use khaak mein mila diya woh naakaam hua.
ayahs.11: (Qaum) Samood ne apni sarkashi ke baais jhutlaya.
ayahs.12: Jab un mein ka bada bad-bakht uth khada hua.
ayahs.13: Unhein Allah ke Rasool ne farma diya tha ke Allah Taala ki ontni aur us ke peene ki baari ki (hifaazat karo).
ayahs.14: In logon ne apne paighambar ko jhoota samajh kar us ontni ki kochein kaat den, pas un ke Rabb ne un ke gunahon ke baais un par halaakat daali aur phir halaakat ko aam kar diya aur us basti ko baraabar kar diya.
ayahs.15: Woh nahin darta us ke tabaah-kun anjaam se.
